rows.note: Use this for strongly hoping that an outcome will happen, rather than addressing a deity or pleading with a person.

example.english: I pray it won't rain tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 m4 hou2 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for humbly pleading with a person, often in 求你 or 求下你啦.

example.english: I pray you give me five more minutes.
example.jyutping: kau4 nei5 bei2 ngo5 do1 ng5 fan1 zung1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for religious prayer; it is the all-purpose verb for addressing a deity or higher being.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaau3 tong4 jap6 min6 kei4 tou2
